title: What changed? Rams make stunning Puka Nacua reversal just one day after McVay’s assurances

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: What changed? Rams make stunning Puka Nacua reversal just one day after McVay’s assurances
sources.description: The Rams reversed course and placed Puka Nacua on injured reserve, sidelining him at least four games and creating a roster dilemma for Sean McVay.
